metadata.title: Coil — AI Stock Scanner & Rules-Based Trading Engine
metadata.description: Coil is an AI stock scanner that hash-commits every score before the market can judge it and publishes its forward-return audit even when negative — right now it does. S&P 500, Nasdaq-100 and a macro book re-scored about every 5 minutes: read the board ($12/mo) or feed it to your own AI agent over MCP ($29/mo). Agents can pay per call in USDC from $0.001.

resources.description: Coil Scanner — decide what to trade now instead of rebuilding it. Scored stock rankings for agents: which of ~560 S&P 500, Nasdaq-100 and macro names are set up to buy, with per-name opportunity, entry-timing and hold-strength scores; risk-on / be-selective / stand-down regime verdicts; ranked buy-list lanes; plus a long-only BTC/ETH trend book. Not raw OHLCV (that's free) — the judgment, read top-down. Refreshed ~5 min in market hours, timestamped. Research, not advice.

resources.description: Point-in-time score history — what did Coil actually publish on a given date? Returns the as-published per-name scores (opportunity percentile, entry quality, hold strength) for every S&P 500 / Nasdaq-100 / macro name on any archived date (?date=YYYY-MM-DD; omit for the list of archived dates). Lookahead-bias-clean by construction: served verbatim from the append-only publish log, never recomputed. Immutable: one new date per session, never revised. Research, not advice.

resources.description: Bitcoin and Ethereum trend signal — is crypto risk-on right now? One read returns the long-only trend state for BTC and ETH (LONG or CASH per sleeve), each sleeve's 50-day trend gate, and the BTC 200-day master gate that overrides both — all evaluated strictly on UTC daily closes, with live price and day change. A rules-based regime verdict for agents, not raw price data. Long-only: the answer is in or out, never short. Research, not advice.

regime.verdict: CASH — BTC closed below its 200-day gate (-10.3%): both sleeves in cash regardless of their own trends, until the gate reopens on a UTC daily close.

example.rules: long-only; each sleeve trades its 50-day gate; BTC's 200-day gate overrides both; states change only on UTC daily closes

resources.description: Day-trade STATE MAP for agents: intraday multi-timeframe conditions on ~70 liquid names (14 market leaders + AI/semis + software cohorts), refreshed ~5 min in US market hours. Per name: an 18-cell lights grid (price/RSI/MACD x 5m-1D), GO (lights x fuel), FUEL vs the tab's anchor ETF, efficiency, ATR%, 20-day vs SPY, entry-window state, and ROOM to the nearest overhead level in % and bars. A state map, NOT a ranking - fully-lit boards flag ext:true (late). Research, not advice.

Per-symbol HOLD-STATE read — is the published trend state behind a name intact? GET /api/board/hold?sym=NVDA (up to 10, comma-separated, one price) returns each name's state, hold strength 0-100, readiness, maturity-late flag, overnight gap-risk grade and its book's regime, with the mechanical rules states flip on. BTC-USD/ETH-USD return the crypto book's IN|CASH daily-close state. Impersonal publication — never your entry or size. ~5-min refresh in market hours. Research, not advice.

resources.description: Sector and macro ROTATION map for agents: where money is actually going, measured as each ETF's ratio to SPY against its own 50-day. ~50 sector + macro ETFs, each labelled GO (leading), HOLDING (paused), TURNING (money arriving) or OUT (lagging), with distance-to-50d %, 20-day slope % and ratio RSI. Pre-bucketed led_by/paused/turning/lagging lists. States and percentages only, never levels. Refreshed every ~5 min in US market hours. Research, not advice.

Every stock in one sector, scored — GET /api/board/sector?name=Energy (or ?etf=XLE) returns each member of that sector with the full Coil read: opportunity 0-100 + percentile, entry quality and state, hold strength, growth score, overnight gap-risk score, leadership flag and dollar volume, ranked by opportunity, plus the sector's own ETF row. All 20 sector groups across the S&P 500, Nasdaq-100 and macro book. ~5-min refresh. Research, not advice.

resources.description: 24/7 crypto day-state board for the Robinhood-tradable universe — 81 coins (BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP, DOGE and more). Per coin: price, 24h/7d change, trend distance vs the 20/50/200-day, ATR%, relative strength vs BTC, multi-timeframe tape lights, volume z-score, room to the 20-day high, mechanical UP/CHOP/DOWN state and cross-sectional rank — plus the daily BTC/ETH gate and breadth. A state map, not a ranking. Refreshed ~15 min around the clock, every day. Research, not advice.

One read scans the full universe for the two washed-shape patterns (daily uptrend + washed-out 5-minute tape) and returns every hit with its GO score, fuel multiple vs BTC, grade and room — plus the setup column for all 81 names. resources.description: TradFi risk-on/risk-off in one $0.003 call for crypto agents. Returns the S&P 500 and Nasdaq-100 regime state, how many equity sectors are green out of 11 (breadth), whether the permission ladder allows risk at all, and the same engine's BTC/ETH trend gate — size against equity risk appetite instead of guessing. Regime states flip rarely (days, not minutes); recomputed ~5-9 min in-session by a live long-only engine scoring ~560 US names. Research, not advice.
